grammarFocus: 人称代词 I / you；be 动词 am / are；句首大写与句号。
title: First Day at the Language School
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。注意：本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。所有题目基于短文内容。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。判断题选择 True、False 或 Not Given。
passage:
A. I am Li Wei. I am a student. This is my first day at the language school. I am from Shanghai. I am in Class A.

B. This is Ms. Chen. She is my teacher. She is from Beijing. She is very kind. She says, "Hello, Li Wei. You are in my class. I am your teacher."

C. I say, "Hello, Ms. Chen. I am happy. You are a good teacher." Ms. Chen says, "Thank you. You are a good student. Goodbye!"
transcript:
Li Wei: Good morning. I am Li Wei. Are you Ms. Chen?
Ms. Chen: Yes, I am. Hello, Li Wei. You are in my class. I am your teacher.
Li Wei: Nice to meet you. I am from Shanghai. Are you from Beijing?
Ms. Chen: Yes, I am. But I am not from Shanghai. I am from Beijing.
Li Wei: Oh, I see. You are from Beijing. I am from Shanghai. We are in the same school.
Ms. Chen: Yes, we are. You are a student. I am a teacher. Goodbye, Li Wei.
Li Wei: Goodbye, Ms. Chen.

grammar.title: 人称代词与be动词
grammar.explanation: 英语中，人称代词I（我）搭配am，you（你）搭配are，he/she/it（他/她/它）搭配is。句首字母要大写，句末用句号。例如：I am Li Wei. You are a student. She is a teacher.
grammar.example: I am Li Wei. You are a student. She is a teacher.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：______ am a student.
选择正确的单词填空：You ______ my teacher.
选择正确的单词填空：She ______ from Beijing.

questions.explanation: 句首字母I要大写，人名Li Wei的首字母也要大写，句末用句号。所以“I am Li Wei.”正确。

transfer.writing: Write 2–8 simple sentences as a short introduction to your new teacher. Include your name, where you are from, your job or school, and how you feel today. Use I am for yourself and You are for the teacher you are addressing. Use real or invented details. Write at least 12 words.
